title: US Army manuals for M880 series (military 1976-77 Dodge W-series)
summary: Army direct and general support manual for the M880 series: military 1976-77 Dodge W200/D200 pickups with the 318 V8 and A-727 automatic. Full scan and OCR text on the Internet Archive.
body:
TM 9-2320-266-34 (January 1976, reprinted with Changes 1-7) covers engine rebuild, A-727 transmission, transfer case, axles, brakes, steering, suspension, body and frame for the M880 family. Full OCR text: https://archive.org/download/micro_IA41152635_0460/micro_IA41152635_0460_djvu.txt

Cited entries built from it: dodge-318-truck-1976-77-specs, dodge-318-cylinder-head-install, dodge-318-valve-timing-check, dodge-a727-fluid-filter-change-m880, dodge-a727-band-adjustment-m880, dodge-a727-gear-selector-linkage-m880, dodge-steering-gear-preload-mesh-m880, dodge-4x4-steering-knuckle-ball-joints-m880, dodge-transfer-case-shift-linkage-m880.
